tellings.difference: Gives the pilot's flight details (20 m over the treetops, moonlight, snow) and the date November 7. The story's telling is about the declassified files.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the November 1975 near-miss between a helicopter and a ghost rocket near the Swedish–Norwegian border. Here the pilot's own account is relayed.

as_told.title: The helicopter pilot's account of the ghost rocket

plain: On November 7, 1975, a helicopter pilot near the border between Sweden and Norway nearly collided with a "ghost rocket", the Swedish name for unexplained rocket-like objects in the sky, according to Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher. Svahn relays what the pilot told him: he was flying 20 metres over the treetops, on a moonlit night, over snow. Svahn says he has been hunting the files of a joint military, customs and police operation from that period, which were sealed until 2040, and that he "just the other day got the clearance" to have them released.
